items.summary: Legal disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, or advertising. Official Woot documentation proves API access mechanics only; current public terms do not establish rights for commercial/public collection, storage, derivatives, caching, display, alerts, or monetization. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate/advertising use. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; keep rights outreach unsent pending counsel review and owner authorization.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closed because direct evidence remains missing. Existing progress: official Woot API/terms/support review, partial repository/configuration evidence, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft site terms. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, deployed data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 analytics is evidence_needed but not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. Produce the consolidated read-only evidence bundle without enabling tracking, expanding alerts, changing production, or adding collection.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue admission is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each property covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence.

Fleet legal posture: ordinary reversible growth is conditional, not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry, when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 18 fail, 6 unknown. Analytics quality is yellow; do not treat unavailable sources as zero. Revenue evidence is limited to $4.92 aggregate unattributed Amazon commission for 2026-09-21; do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, or causal lift.
